verdict.rationale: Bruno is local-first with no cloud sync, no account, and collections stored as plain text files on the user's own filesystem, giving users complete control over retention/deletion simply by managing local files; AI features use a Bring-Your-Own-Key model where 'no data is routed through Bruno servers,' further limiting third-party retention exposure. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/export tooling or audit trail, documented data-retention policy for enterprise AI governance beyond BYOK, and independent verification of these privacy claims.
